## SACAS

Read `Structure/ROUTER.md` before acting. It is the canonical entry point for SACAS rules, task context, and generated navigation.

GitHub Copilot does not provide a repository-local ignore file. Configure exclusions through administrator settings. Repository and organization content exclusions do not protect Copilot CLI, cloud, or agent mode.
